submitted.rationale: Photocurrent goes up as the film gets richer in V: Nb0.72 gave 1.63 µA, Nb0.45 gave 5.51 µA and Nb0.467 gave 5.64 µA. XRD on indices 7, 0 and 13 (Nb 0.45 to 0.59) shows the same crystal structure throughout, with only a small extra peak at Q≈1.83 at index 0. So photocurrent likely changes smoothly with composition across this range, with no phase change to create a sharp peak. The best region is the V-rich end, and index 2 has the highest photocurrent measured.
